findings.title: Concurrent same-author tool errors merge thought id
findings.problem: _active_error_streak in AgentStreamingCallback.on_tool_error is keyed only by author, not by run_id or tool-call. When parallel tool calling is enabled and two tool calls from the same author fail concurrently rather than as sequential retries, the second error's thought.id is aliased onto the first error's already-existing streak id.
findings.impact: The UI shows one tool's error message under the wrong tool's visible thought, hiding which of the two concurrently-failing tools actually produced which error.
findings.recommendation: Scope the streak key by (author, originating run_id/tool_call chain) or only alias thought.id when the new error's call genuinely chains from the same prior tool call.

findings.title: Consecutive-error cap not scoped per subagent
findings.problem: self._consecutive_tool_error_count is a single scalar on the LangGraphAgent instance whose own _stream_graph loop is actually executing. All tool-error events across subagents are dispatched through the one top-level instance's shared counter.
findings.impact: AC6 requires each subagent to track its own independent error streak; instead the shared counter lets a broken subagent's success reset it, and unrelated errors across subagents can accumulate and abort the whole run.
findings.recommendation: Key the counter by author (a dict), incrementing/resetting per author rather than on the single instance-wide scalar.

findings.title: Tool-error cap skips thought finalization
findings.problem: _on_tool_error raises MaxConsecutiveToolErrorsExceededException as soon as the cap is reached, before reaching the existing call to self._callback_bridge.on_tool_error(...) a few lines below, which is the only code path that finalizes the triggering tool's Thought.
findings.impact: The tool call that triggers the fatal abort has its Thought left permanently 'in progress' in the UI, reproducing the ticket's original defect for the one call that ends the run.
findings.recommendation: Call self._callback_bridge.on_tool_error(...) before or regardless of raising MaxConsecutiveToolErrorsExceededException.

finding_status.notes: New _inflight_run_ids set per author distinguishes concurrent same-author errors from sequential retries; only sequential retries alias thought.id, verified against current source and hand-traced through both scenarios.
